description: Trait atoms. The character generator draws contradictory pairs from these pools. scrape_characters.py appends mined, abstracted atoms here with provenance — never source prose, never source names.

wound.text: was given away to settle someone else's obligation
watched a protector fail publicly and survived the fallout alone
was the one spared when others were not, and never learned why
had a formative achievement credited to someone else
lost a first language and with it a way of being loved
was right about a danger nobody believed until it arrived
spent childhood as the caretaker of an adult
grew up where affection arrived only after measurable output

lie.text: Worth is a balance you must keep positive.
If I stop being useful, I stop being tolerated.
Anyone who truly sees me will leave, so show them a version that stays.
Suffering I chose is not suffering.
The world owes me a correction, and I am entitled to collect it.
Wanting more than I was given is a kind of theft.
A clean conscience is worth more than a saved life.

mask.text: relentless warmth used as a perimeter
precision about small things to avoid precision about large ones
makes themselves the joke first, so no one else can
stillness mistaken for depth, protecting a loud interior
borrowed certainty worn like armor over a private doubt
cultivated unseriousness hiding a decade-long plan
principle invoked at exactly the moment it is convenient
reasonableness used as a battering ram
asks the one question the room agreed not to ask
intimacy offered fast and withdrawn faster
hospitality kept as a ledger of who owes an evening
changes the subject with a joke sharp enough to leave a mark

competence.text: reads financial instruments the way others read faces
can hold a body together with improvised materials
knows who in any room actually decides
acquires dialects and registers unnervingly fast
repairs machines by listening to them
gets into places without force or permission
predicts crowd mood and its turn
recalls exact wording of anything ever said to them
can be forgotten at will; people lose them in memory
can move a room's decision without appearing to speak first
reconstructs a stranger's whole situation from three questions
finds the load-bearing lie in an argument and pulls it
can value anything, including people, within a minute of seeing it
notices the injury a person is hiding before they admit it
can make an entire group forget who raised a subject

incompetence.text: cannot apologize without making it a transaction
cannot accept a gift without immediate repayment
can deceive by omission for years but cannot say a direct falsehood
flinches at kindness faster than at threat
brilliant under pressure, useless at a dinner table
has no register between composure and scorched earth

verbal_tic.text: phrases everything as terms and conditions
slips into third person when frightened
quotes regulations verbatim as a weapon
answers questions with questions when cornered
gives everyone a nickname within a minute of meeting
drops articles and pronouns when the stakes rise
buries certainties in qualifiers, then acts on them absolutely
goes silent for exactly as long as it takes to unnerve
repeats your own words back, unaltered, until you hear them
keeps perfect grammar while saying something unforgivable

physical_signature.text: hands always doing a second task
unnatural stillness that makes others fidget
an old injury that only shows when they are lying
ink or grease permanently under the nails
takes up less space than their body requires
carries a smell that belongs to a place they left

loyalty_shape.text: loyal to terms, not people; will honor a bad deal to the letter
one absolute loyalty, everything else negotiable
loyal to the institution over every individual in it
loyal until the debt is settled, then gone without malice
always loyal to whoever is currently losing
loyal to a version of someone that does not exist yet

fear.text: becoming the person who hurt them
stopping, and what arrives in the silence
owing something that cannot be repaid
having been wrong for a very long time

moral_axis.text: the few known vs the many unknown

offstage_life.text: quietly teaching someone the thing they were denied
paying down an obligation nobody knows about
assembling a file on someone powerful
maintaining a place or person the story has not shown
losing a private battle on a schedule
running a second, incompatible life in another district

arc_shape.text: flat arc: changes others, not themselves
slow thaw, earned by small repeated acts
tragic fall visible to everyone but them
leaves, is changed, returns unrecognizable to those who stayed
holds, holds, holds, then breaks in one irreversible scene

entry_pretext.text: stands between the POV and something already wanted
arrives carrying information the plot has made necessary
attached to an institution the POV just entered
pursuing an unrelated goal that crosses the POV's path
called in by an established character under pressure
a name already spoken in the text, arriving in person

contradiction_rules: Pair a mask with a competence it cannot protect.
Pair a fear with a loyalty_shape that guarantees the fear is realized.
Pair a lie with a competence that makes the lie look true for a long time.
Never give a character a wound and a lie from the same axis without a third element that complicates both.
